sourceText:
Mariscada
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 11:42pm

Ingredients




1 cup Basic Brazilian Tomato Sauce (see recipe), pureed
4 inches lrg clams  shells
3 raw shrimp unshelled
1 1/4 pounds lobster split
4 sea scallops
1 cup Basic Brazilian Tomato Sauce (see recipe),
unpureed
Chopped fresh parsley for garnish

Preparation

1 Place 1 cup of pureed Basic Brazilian Tomato Sauce in an individual casserole dish. Arrange clams in casserole. Cover. 2 Bake in 400 degree oven 5 minutes. Add shrimp and lobster. Cover. 3 Return to oven and bake 10 minutes. Add scallops. Top with 1 cup of unpureed Basic Brazilian Tomato Sauce. Return to oven 5 to 10 minutes until all seafood is tender and cooked. 4 Serve in covered dish sprinkled with chopped parsley to garnish. 5 This recipe yields 1 serving.
